requested_peak: End-of-epoch sampled requested-managed-byte maximum; not allocation-by-allocation transient high water.
charged_peak: End-of-epoch sampled finite-pool charge maximum; zero means unavailable/system mode, not zero libc footprint.
heap_thresholds: Checked after each completed epoch; exact managed recovery checked at1024-epoch drains.
rss_peak_bytes: Maximum observed ps RSS, sampled every30s (plus initial observation), not an instantaneous physical-memory bound.
absolute_monotonic_origin: Not persisted by this initial driver. C reports exact elapsed monotonic duration; UTC launch is recorded separately.
artifact_policy: Executables are active scratch; retain hashes below, remove binaries after active cohort ends. Runtime/source/log/summary evidence remains durable.
